```yaml
name: Secrets Diagnostics
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  secrets-diagnostic:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          go mod download
          go install github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/cmd/golangci-lint@latest

      - name: Run linters
        run: |
          golangci-lint run ./...

      - name: Build project
        run: |
          go build -o gh-aw ./cmd/gh-aw

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          go test -v ./...

      - name: Validate token fallback chain implementation
        run: |
          # Check if token fallback logic is properly implemented
          echo "Validating token fallback chain in source files..."
          
          # Verify getEffectiveAgentGitHubToken function has proper parameters
          if grep -q "toplevelToken" cmd/gh-aw/*.go; then
            echo "✓ toplevelToken parameter found"
          else
            echo "✗ toplevelToken parameter not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Verify token precedence chain
          if grep -q "GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN.*GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN.*GITHUB_TOKEN" cmd/gh-aw/*.go; then
            echo "✓ Token precedence chain found"
          else
            echo "✗ Token precedence chain not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Verify callers pass full token chain
          callers=("safe_outputs_steps.go" "safe_outputs_env.go" "copilot_participant_steps.go" "create_issue.go")
          for caller in "${callers[@]}"; do
            if [ -f "cmd/gh-aw/$caller" ]; then
              echo "✓ $caller exists"
            else
              echo "✗ $caller not found"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          
          echo "All validations passed!"
```
